name: Roasted Peri Peri Makhana
ingredients:
Makhana (Fox - Nuts 70%), Edible Vegetable Oil (Sunflower), Seasoning [Sugar, lodised Salt, Onion Powder, Tomato Powder, Flavours [Natural (Spice), Nature Identical (Tomato)], Spice & Condiments (0.8%) (Chilli (0.6%), Ginger), Garlic Powder (0.5%), Acidity Regulator (INS 330), Yeast Extract, Black Salt, Hydrolysed Vegetable Protein, Lemon Powder, Flavour Enhancers (INS 627, INS 631) and Anticaking Agent (INS 551)].
